scope: Proposition 6.2 of the manuscript “Logarithmic Kodaira dimension and whole-fiber variation” (preprints/Logarithmic-Kodaira-dimension-and-whole-fiber-variation-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 033 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b1b750b309e5c5a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 47. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: After a finite extension of b(I) there is a normal projective variety V ′ over b, finite over P0, such that the generic I-fiber of H0 is birational over P0 to the base extension of V ′. Equivalently, after replacing I by a smooth projective model of that finite extension, there is a birational product description over I ×b P0, (6.4) H0 99K I ×b V ′ . Here H0 denotes the main component after the parameter extension. Every component of the old B0 which has a divisorial image on V ′ over the generic point of I has an image defined over b. Put (6.5) k = b(V ′ ), K = k(I). The original generic x-fiber, viewed by (6.4) as a variety J/K, is geometrically birational to a smooth projective geometrically integral variety J0/k. One has κ(J0,k̄) = 0, and, for the minimal positive pluricanonical index p of J, there is a nonzero ordinary p-pluricanonical form on J0 and (6.6) dimk H0 (J0, pKJ0 ) = dimk̄ H0 (J0,k̄, pKJ0,k̄ ) = 1.
